meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装 rtk 代理，自动压缩 Bash 命令的输出，节省 60–90% 的 token。运行 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令时，Claude 会通过 rtk 处理，减少 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当你在容器中执行 Bash 工具调用（如 git status、cargo build）时触发。需要先完成安装和配置步骤。

say.text: 运行 git status 查看仓库状态。
say.note: rtk 会自动压缩输出，节省 token。

say.text: 执行 cargo build 编译项目。
say.note: 编译输出会被 rtk 压缩。
测试输出同样经过压缩。

howto.what_en: Installs the rtk proxy to automatically compress output of Bash commands, saving 60–90% tokens. When Claude runs dev commands like git, cargo, pytest, etc., they are routed through rtk to reduce token consumption.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you execute a Bash tool call (e.g., git status, cargo build) inside the container. Requires prior installation and configuration steps.

say_en.text: Run git status to check the repository state.
say_en.note: rtk automatically compresses the output, saving tokens.

say_en.text: Execute cargo build to compile the project.
say_en.note: Build output is compressed by rtk.
